Label: Weighted accessibility of initial vaccination centers
Source: Derived from drive-time isochrone analysis around initial mass vaccination center(s).
Notes: A refined accessibility score measuring the proportion of each LEA (Local Electoral Area) within 10-, 20-, 30-, and 60-minute drive-time isochrones of the initial vaccination center. The overlapping areas are inversely weighted by travel time to reflect decreasing accessibility with increasing distance.

Label: Accessibility of Pharmacies within 10-minute drive-time
Source: Derived from 10-minute drive-time isochrone analysis around community pharmacies.
Notes: Proportion of each LEA covered by a 10-minute drive-time catchment from one or more pharmacy locations.

Label: Accessibility of GP clinics within 10-minute drive-time
Source: Derived from 10-minute drive-time isochrone analysis around GP (General Practitioner) clinics.
Notes: Proportion of each LEA within a 10-minute drive-time catchment from GP clinics.
